title: Add pronouns to autocomplete attribute

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

body:
### What problem are you trying to solve?

I would like to improve the autocomplete attribute by adding some things.

First I would like to add a token to the list of the autofill field names. This token is "pronouns". We could write an heuristic to get one from "sex" but this is a lot of work for a  clunky and error-prone solution. Letting the user autodetermine themselves is far easier. Asking for pronouns is quite a basic nowadays. Here is some example:

Discord:
![Discord screenshot of pronoun input](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b97b65a8-6669-4cda-895d-df09068ed045)

GitHub:
![GitHub screenshot of pronoun dropdown](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65d1e5bb-4ad3-405d-87d0-f9f28e39bc7c)

LinkedIn:

![LinkedIn screenshot of pronoun dropdown](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aac8de41-1d68-4f70-98fd-15e49235524d)

Codeberg:

![Codeberg screenshot of pronoun dropdown](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8abdc318-c44a-4db6-8c74-79fcc6eb2c96)


So the spec could look like this:

| Field name | Meaning | Canonical Format | Canonical Format Example | Control group |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "sex" | Gender identity (e.g. Female, Fa'afafine) | Free-form text, no newlines | Male | [Text](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#control-group-text) |
| "pronouns" | Pronouns (e.g. he/him, she/her, they/them) | Free-form text, no newlines | he/him | [Text](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#control-group-text) |


More information on Wikipedia : https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pronoun

### What solutions exist today?

Mostly having a empty field for pronouns without autocomplete or a dropdown

### How would you solve it?

Extend the spec

### Anything else?
